programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Toronto Maple Leafs host the Edmonton Oilers in NHL regular-season play at Scotiabank Arena. Toronto have won four of the last five meetings, including a 7-2 rout in Edmonton just three weeks ago. Connor McDavid leads Edmonton in points.
